name: Semantic Radiance Field Rendering
definition: Renders semantic logits through volume rendering to generate point-wise semantic labels for simulated LiDAR points, using weak 2D image labels as supervision.
summary: Semantic Radiance Field Rendering generates point-wise semantic labels for simulated LiDAR by volume-rendering semantic logits, differing from standard NeRF by outputting semantic distributions rather than just RGB color.
